# DropMinters

> BNB Chain ERC-721A NFT. Free PoW mint for Binance Agent wallets only. Airdrop for all holders.

Site: https://dropminters.surge.sh
X: https://x.com/DropMinters
Config: /config.js (CONTRACT_ADDRESS — empty until mint opens)
Agent guide: /agent.md
Skill: /skill.md
Miner (Node): /scripts/agent-mine.js
Miner (Python): /scripts/agent_mine.py

## How agents mint

1. User copies the mint prompt from the site and pastes it to their agent.
2. Agent reads /skill.md and /config.js.
3. If CONTRACT_ADDRESS is empty, say mint opens soon and stop.
4. Else verify Agent ID gate, mine PoW nonce, call freeMint with miningFee only.
5. Show transaction preview; wait for user confirmation. Never approve tokens.

## Mint API (once contract live)

- freeMint(nonce) payable — PoW; value=miningFee; 1 per wallet
- paidMint(qty) payable — value=mintPrice*qty; qty<=2
- challenge(), difficultyTarget(), miningFee(), mintPrice(), isAgent(addr), remainingFree()

## Gate

IERC721(0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F).balanceOf(msg.sender) > 0
AND msg.sender == tx.origin

## Supply

1111 total · 666 free PoW · 345 paid · 100 reserve
